PRINT THE DECK.

54-card print-and-play prototype · 40 ordinary numbers + RESET ×2 · GHOST ×2 · UNDER ×2 · SKIP ×2 · BURN ×4 · DUMP ×2

Back to gameView full deckPlaytest rules + scorecard
Prototype printing: Print at 100% / actual size, A4 portrait. Fronts have 9 cards per page, with cut lines. Optional backs are on separate sheets; for reliable alignment, print fronts and backs separately or use opaque sleeves and identical standard cards. Test one sheet before printing all 54 cards. The six front sheets and six back sheets each have nine cards. The digital table and printable deck use the same illustrated artwork. Matching special cards can be played together, with their action resolved once per group.
